description: Compare two to five public pricing pages side by side before you make competitive pricing or packaging claims. Use this when you want a quick, live comparison of visible prices, free-plan signals, and plan-name hints across vendors. The output is heuristic and page-level: it does not map every price to every plan or normalize regional billing differences.

pages.description: Two to five named pricing pages to compare side by side.

name.description: Short vendor or product label to use in the comparison output.

url.description: Public pricing page URL for that vendor or product.

name: compare_pricing_pages

pages.description: Per-page pricing signals returned in input order.

cached.description: True when this page body came from the 5-minute cache.

error.description: Fetch or parsing error for this specific pricing page when it could not be analyzed.

hasFreeOption.description: True when this page contains visible text suggesting a free plan, free tier, or $0 option.

hasFreeTrial.description: True when this page contains visible text suggesting a free trial.

name.description: Short vendor or product label from the input page object.

pageLength.description: Size of this fetched page body in characters.

plansDetected.description: Lowercased heuristic plan labels detected on this page, such as free, pro, team, or enterprise.

pricesFound.description: Distinct price-like strings extracted from this page. These are page-level hints and are not mapped to specific plans.

url.description: Pricing page URL that was fetched for this named vendor.

summary.description: Aggregate counts across all compared pricing pages.

pagesCompared.description: Number of pricing pages included in the comparison.

pagesWithFreeOption.description: Number of pages with page-level text suggesting a free plan, free tier, or $0 option.

pagesWithFreeTrial.description: Number of pages with page-level text suggesting a free trial.

pagesWithVisiblePrices.description: Number of pages where at least one price-like string was detected.

title: Pricing Page Comparison
